title: D-091 TW4: Linux recertification of the controller (recapture fixtures for the installed claude and codex, update the re-baseline tests, cert report)
objective: After TW1-TW3 merge, recertify the controller on this Linux server: recapture the capability-probe fixture (installed claude and codex versions, [HOME]-masked), the shell-routing and native-runtime-detection fixtures, run the bash shell-routing harness, update the version-pinned re-baseline tests so the live drift checks pass, and write the certification report. All local probes; no provider call; no root or systemd step (those are owner-typed in TW5).
business_reason: Owner directive D-091: move the loop to the cloud server with Codex and Claude reviews and a combining model.
forbidden_paths: any tools/agent_supervisor/*.py source change other than the event_drift.py hook-catalog re-point (the M0-T159 recertification precedent); a source change after this task voids the certification
creating /etc/nyc-supervisor/config.toml or installing systemd units (owner-typed, TW5)
starting or commissioning a live loop, or any owner-typed step (runbook section 12)
codex login or handling any owner credential
weakening any fail-closed check, gate, reviewer-independence rule or the orchestrator's sole authority (ADR-005)
Windows behavior changes: existing Windows paths and tests must keep passing unchanged
acceptance_scenarios: primary: the live re-probe tests for claude and codex pass on this server against the new fixtures
the re-baseline invariant pins the new versions; the old fixtures are kept, not deleted
the bash shell-routing harness passes with all mutants detected
failure: a probe that cannot run fails closed and the certification is not claimed
risks: recertification: every tools/agent_supervisor/** edit invalidates the frozen certification; one recertification task runs after all D-091 code tasks
